components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 72px; padding-left: 16px; background: #fff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; width: 360px; } .ds-avatar { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 26px; margin-right: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; background: #e4ecfa; color: #00326b; font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-row-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 16px 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(15,26,42,0.08); } .ds-row-top, .ds-row-bottom { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-name { font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f1a2a; } .ds-time { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #0b7a3e; margin-left: 8px; } .ds-msg { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: #0f1a2a; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge { min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 11px; background: #0e8344; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-left: 8px; } .ds-row:active { opacity: 0.6; }

narrative.overview:
SAC Mobile is a white messaging inbox finished to the level of the apps its users already know: WhatsApp Business, Telegram, a Zoho or Intercom team inbox, Google Messages. Agents and owners use it one-handed, in short bursts, often in daylight, so the system chooses familiarity and legibility over novelty. The ground is white; neutrals are tinted toward navy; navy carries brand, titles and primary actions; green appears only for unread and success.

The system rejects the earlier pale-blue card-on-card dashboard look and decorative borders. Structure comes from spacing, tonal wells and a single inset hairline. Plus Jakarta Sans is the only typeface, on one type scale.

The conversation screen is outside this system and keeps its WhatsApp-like look.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, navy-tinted wells (surface-well) instead of cards and borders.
Navy for brand and action, green only for unread and success.
Round avatars, pill search, pill filter chips, Material 3 bottom bar with a tinted pill indicator.
Rows over cards: lists are hairline-divided rows, not boxed tiles.
Light and dark themes share one token set (dark values in the sidecar).

rules.name: The Green Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Green means unread or success and nothing else. A chat that does not need a reply never shows green.

rules.name: The Navy Acts Rule
rules.body: Navy marks identity and the thing you can do next (titles, FAB, selected state). Decoration never uses it.

rules.name: The Theme Token Rule
rules.body: Colour comes from colors.* so dark mode follows. A literal hex in a screen is drift.

rules.name: The Weight Carries State Rule
rules.body: Unread is shown by weight and colour together. Do not add size changes.

rules.name: The Flat Rows Rule
rules.body: Rows, search, chips and the tab bar carry no shadow. Only controls that float above the list may.

dos: Do read colours from useThemeStore().colors and render text through src/components/ui/Text.tsx.
Do reserve green for unread and success, and navy for brand and primary action.
Do build lists as hairline-divided rows with the divider inset from the avatar.
Do keep touch targets at least 36px tall (chips, filter button) and rows 64px or more.
Do give dark mode the same structure with DARK_COLORS; verify both themes on a device.
Do leave the chat conversation screen alone; it keeps its WhatsApp-like look.
donts: Don't return to pale-blue card-on-card dashboards or boxed groups for lists.
Don't add decorative borders or shadows to rows, chips, search or the tab bar.
Don't use green for anything that is not unread or success.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a weight outside 400, 500, 600, 700 (800 collapses to 700).
Don't hard-code hex values in screens; add a token instead.
